value.title: Girls & Panzer - Operation: More Love Love! [4] (Act 2, Part 1)
value.synopsis: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu (MLLSD) is a four-act series adapting the Girls und Panzer spin-off manga 'Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu!'. Unlike the main series, MLLSD focuses on the daily life of characters instead of Sensha-do matches.
